compendium.summary: A high-ceiling, source-dependent summon with genuine loss-of-control risk. Place it where a hostile outcome is containable; it is not a safe default pet.
warnings: Expanded-source permission is required; owning the book or seeing a spell in a builder is not campaign approval.
Tier is a situational Compendium assessment, not a letter grade quoted from Pack Tactics.
Full paid spell mechanics were not independently rechecked; consult the linked active entry before using detailed interactions.
tactics: Agree on the allowed demon entry, its commands and control-loss procedure before play. Do not assume a historical monster stat block is the campaign's active one.
Containment and retreat routes are part of the spell choice. Keeping allies away from a potential uncontrolled demon is more important than maximizing a theoretical damage chart.

Planar Binding is a separate setup problem: its hour-long casting requires concentration. One Wizard cannot normally sustain this summon while casting Binding; use a valid second caster or an explicitly approved alternative.

research.note: Prompted by the supplied Pack Tactics research package. Video timestamps are its attribution trail, not independently verified quotations; editorial advice is separated from official spell access.
